result: after save v(out) v('x1:mid') i(v1): op1 [out, x1:mid, v1:flow(br)], but ac1 [in, out, v1:flow(br), x1:mid] and nz1 every n(); save dv(out) dv('x1:mid') di(v1): ac2 [out, x1:mid, v1:flow(br)]; save n(r3) n('x1:r1'): nz2 [n(r3), n(x1:r1)]; the column names are the same in every case
